summary.result: The results suggest that the methods used in the study can be applied to estimate pollutant load of different land cover watersheds using limited data.
summary.background: The purpose of this study was to develop a ridge regression (RR) model to estimate BOD and TP load using runoff weighted value.
summary.method: The RR model was developed for five flow duration intervals with the independent variables of daily runoff discharge of seven land covers and dependent variables of daily pollutant load.
